name: What are the safety considerations for outdoor fireplaces?

mainEntity.name: What are the safety considerations for outdoor fireplaces?

acceptedAnswer.text: Safety is paramount for outdoor fireplaces. Key considerations include maintaining proper clearances from combustible materials such as fences, trees, and your home's eaves, as specified by local building codes. Ensure a stable, non-combustible foundation. For wood-burning units, use a spark arrestor and never leave a fire unattended. For gas units, professional installation of gas lines and regular inspections are crucial to prevent leaks. Good ventilation is also important. Always have a fire extinguisher or water source readily available, and educate all users on safe operation practices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Safety requires proper clearances from combustibles, a stable foundation, spark arrestors for wood, professional gas line installation, and constant supervision.
